selected_evidence.requirement: Create opsbot accounts and provision node1's key access to node2
selected_evidence.summary: Shows account creation, node1 key generation, node2 authorized-key installation, and restrictive ownership and permissions.

selected_evidence.requirement: Require key-based authentication for opsbot on both systems
selected_evidence.summary: Effective sshd policy requires publickey and disables password and keyboard-interactive authentication; no-key attempts are rejected with Permission denied (publickey).

selected_evidence.requirement: Run commands as opsbot from node1 on node2
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after both reboots, node1 authenticated without password fallback, ran as opsbot uid 1000 on node2, and created opsbot-owned files.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Both nodes remained on CentOS Stream 10 with kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64; no software installation or OS/kernel replacement occurred.

Captures healthy baseline boot ID 83a0a80f-773c-4f3e-9137-1e7aa887b07a, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 34e2e001-9535-48ee-9a4c-84e6593cca9c, recovered sshd/policy/key data, and restored node1→node2 access.

Captures healthy baseline boot ID 5e93a57c-0d8d-454e-8fb1-617b2a46810c, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 2c6e198a-9bab-485d-910a-df874b3c238e, recovered sshd/policy/authorized-key data, and successful end-to-end key access after both restarts.

commands.command:
set -eu
if ! id opsbot >/dev/null 2>&1; then useradd -m -s /bin/bash opsbot; fi
passwd -l opsbot >/dev/null
install -d -m 700 -o opsbot -g opsbot /home/opsbot/.ssh
if [ ! -f /home/opsbot/.ssh/id_ed25519 ]; then sudo -u opsbot -- ssh-keygen -q -t ed25519 -N '' -C 'opsbot@node1' -f /home/opsbot/.ssh/id_ed25519; fi
cp /home/opsbot/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub /home/opsbot/.ssh/authorized_keys
chown opsbot:opsbot /home/opsbot/.ssh/authorized_keys
chmod 600 /home/opsbot/.ssh/authorized_keys
restorecon -RF /home/opsbot/.ssh >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
id opsbot
stat -c '%U:%G %a %n' /home/opsbot/.ssh /home/opsbot/.ssh/id_ed25519 /home/opsbot/.ssh/authorized_keys
passwd -S opsbot

commands.command:
set -eu
cat > /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/60-opsbot.conf <<'OPSBOT_EOF'
Match User opsbot
    PubkeyAuthentication yes
    AuthenticationMethods publickey
    PasswordAuthentication no
    KbdInteractiveAuthentication no
    PermitEmptyPasswords no
OPSBOT_EOF
chmod 600 /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/60-opsbot.conf
sshd -t
systemctl reload sshd
systemctl is-active sshd
sshd -T -C user=opsbot,host="$NODE_NAME",addr="$NODE_IP" | grep -E '^(pubkeyauthentication|authenticationmethods|passwordauthentication|kbdinteractiveauthentication|permitemptypasswords) '
commands.stdout:
active
pubkeyauthentication yes
passwordauthentication no
kbdinteractiveauthentication no
permitemptypasswords no
